numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across seasons: Season 1 is 1-24, Season 2 is 25-47 and Season 3 (Culling Game Part 1) is 48-59 (Anime Filler Guide numbering).

arcs.name: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
arcs.summary: A year before the series, a cursed boy named Yuta Okkotsu, haunted by the spirit of his childhood friend Rika, is brought to Jujutsu High by Satoru Gojo.
events: Yuta learns to control Rika's overwhelming curse while training with Maki, Toge and Panda.
The rogue sorcerer Suguru Geto declares the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons to take Rika for himself.
Yuta lifts Rika's curse, and Gojo kills his old best friend Geto.

arcs.name: Introduction / Fearsome Womb
arcs.summary: High schooler Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed finger of the King of Curses, Ryomen Sukuna, to save his friends and is pulled into the world of jujutsu sorcerers.
events: Yuji becomes Sukuna's vessel and is sentenced to death, with execution postponed until he eats all the fingers.
Yuji joins Megumi Fushiguro and Nobara Kugisaki as first-years at Jujutsu High.
During the cursed-womb mission, Sukuna rips out Yuji's heart and Yuji dies, only to be revived.

arcs.name: Vs. Mahito
arcs.summary: Secretly revived and training under Gojo, Yuji investigates strange deaths tied to a soul-warping curse working with a group of conspirators.
events: Gojo shows his domain expansion, Unlimited Void, against Jogo.
Yuji befriends Junpei Yoshino, whom Mahito manipulates and then kills.
Yuji and Nanami fight Mahito, whose soul-shaping touch backfires on Yuji because Sukuna shares his body.

arcs.name: Kyoto Goodwill Event
arcs.summary: The Tokyo and Kyoto jujutsu schools face off in a sister-school exchange, but the Kyoto side has orders to kill Yuji.
events: Yuji wins over Aoi Todo, and they land a series of Black Flashes together.
Curses invade the event, and a special-grade cursed spirit is beaten back.
The cursed user Mahito's group steals Sukuna's fingers and other cursed objects.

arcs.name: Death Painting
arcs.summary: Yuji and Nobara chase after the Death Paintings, cursed wombs given form as brothers.
events: Yuji and Nobara defeat Eso and Kechizu.
Yuji kills for the first time and struggles with it.
Hints emerge of a spy inside Jujutsu High.

arcs.name: Gojo's Past (Hidden Inventory / Premature Death)
arcs.summary: Years earlier, students Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto are assigned to protect the Star Plasma Vessel, a girl named Riko Amanai.
events: Toji Fushiguro kills Riko and nearly kills Gojo.
Gojo awakens Reverse Cursed Technique and kills Toji.
Geto loses faith in protecting non-sorcerers and leaves the jujutsu world.

arcs.name: Shibuya Incident
arcs.summary: On Halloween, a barrier traps Shibuya, and curses and rogue sorcerers spring a trap aimed at Gojo.
events: Gojo is sealed in the Prison Realm by 'Geto', revealed to be Kenjaku.
Sukuna takes over Yuji and kills thousands.
Nanami and Nobara are struck down by Mahito.
Kenjaku absorbs Mahito and starts the Culling Game.

arcs.name: Itadori Extermination
arcs.summary: In Shibuya's aftermath, the jujutsu world's leaders order Yuji's execution.
events: Yuta Okkotsu returns as Yuji's appointed executioner.
Yuta fakes Yuji's death and teams up with him.

arcs.name: Perfect Preparation
arcs.summary: As the Culling Game's rules come to light, the surviving sorcerers make a plan to free Gojo.
events: The rules of the Culling Game are explained.
Maki wipes out the Zen'in clan.
Megumi is made head of the Zen'in clan.

arcs.name: Culling Game (Tokyo No. 1 & Sendai Colonies)
arcs.summary: Yuji and the others enter the colonies of the Culling Game.
events: Yuji fights the reincarnated sorcerer Higuruma in the Tokyo No. 1 colony.
Yuta enters the Sendai colony and battles its strongest players.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
